text:
racheal_cs: Heads-up — I'm drafting a short pocket ops playbook CSMs can hand to customers during onboarding and pre-renewal checks. Goal: reduce renewal risk by standardizing prefill/delta-sync, caching, batching, and streaming best-practices. Need quick checklist + who owns each step.
anya_csm: love this. Can we make it a 1-page checklist + 2x example configs? CSMs just want copy-paste action items. :100: 
racheal_cs: yep — thinking header sections: quick health signals, prefill cadence, delta-sync windowing, recommended cache TTLs, batch sizing heuristics, streaming fallback options, and feedback capture hooks.
tom_eng: suggest we include a tiny code block for prefill job example and a curl for turning on streaming in client SDK. keep it small.
liam_sre: also include a quick SLO-friendly note: if latency > 300ms p50 on interactive routes, prefer smaller batches or enable prefix-KV cache.
anya_csm: draft checklist idea: 1) Account health snapshot 2) Prefill: run 24h before demo 3) Warm pools enabled 4) Client delta-sync at 5m windows 5) Fallbacks: short-circuit to smaller model or cached response.
racheal_cs: adding owners: CSM runs account health snapshot; Eng (tom) provides prefill job template; SRE (liam) owns warm-pool provisioning and latency thresholds; CSM captures feedback.
tom_eng: here's a minimal prefill job snippet we can give customers (feel free to shorten):
```yaml
# prefill-job.yaml
job: prefill_v1
schedule: "24h-before-launch"
requests:
  - prompt_set: tenant_warmup
  - concurrency: 4
  - max_tokens: 256
  - cache_policy: prefix
  - cache_ttl_secs: 86400
```
anya_csm: perfect. Also include a delta-sync example for event-driven updates (CSMs: set to 5-10m depending on traffic).
liam_sre: delta-sync note: prefer idempotent updates and low-cardinality keys; if deltas bigger than 50kb, switch to chunking and streaming via websocket.
tom_eng: streaming tips: enable chunked responses, set keepalive 30s, and include a server-side short-circuit that returns cached answer if generation exceeds 1.2s.
anya_csm: feedback capture: add a quick survey hook after first 5 live requests: "Did the response match expectations?" store responses in support ticket and tag by prompt set.
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: send playbook draft to #customer-success-docs in 24h.
racheal_cs: ok next steps: Tom — shorten the YAML to a 3-line example and add curl snippet for client enablement. Liam — add the latency/fallback thresholds in one line. Anya — I'll format the 1-pager and include the feedback hook text.
anya_csm: I'll prep 2 templated emails: (1) pre-launch enablement checklist for customer, (2) renewal-risk touchpoint email with health snapshot attached.
tom_eng: quick curl example for enabling streaming (to include in one-pager):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions/stream -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"open-llm-3","stream":true,"keepalive":30}'
```
liam_sre: final thought — add an escalation line: if renewal risk score > 0.7 AND average latency rising, schedule a 30-min triage with ENG+SRE+CSM.
racheal_cs: love it. I'll assemble and drop into #customer-success-docs for review. thanks all :thumbsup:
anya_csm: thanks — will test the templates with two pilots this week and report back.
onboard-bot: Thread closed automatically after post in 72h unless replied to."
